scope: GR00T N1.5 on RoboCasa365 target-posttraining checkpoints

prospective_from_this_file: scores for the three previously unscored structural candidates on Atomic-Seen and Composite-Seen
scores for all six corrected candidates on Composite-Unseen
all hardware latency, peak-memory, and energy results

complete_policy_evaluation.hypothesis: At least one corrected proposal reduces both task-clustered complete-policy deviation metrics relative to context_base without violating any component guard.
complete_policy_evaluation.null_outcome: No proposal passes; retain context_base and report abstention.
complete_policy_evaluation.selection_buffer: four tasks per split, three task-seed sequences per task, four replans per sequence; 144 observations total
complete_policy_evaluation.teacher: original native BF16/FP16 checkpoint for each split
complete_policy_evaluation.candidate_runtime: signed packed group-64 W4 weights with dynamic per-forward per-channel A8 and four flow steps
complete_policy_evaluation.primary_objective: J_teacher=max over D_func/D_PAC and all registered task clusters of (mean task delta + corrected task-mean SE)/context_base task-macro scale
complete_policy_evaluation.acceptance: strict J_teacher < 0 and mean task delta + SE <= 0 for pose, stitch, and gripper; equality fails
complete_policy_evaluation.candidate_state_rule: If any candidates pass the teacher-state screen, audit at most the three best teacher-state candidates on their own rollout observations and require J_final=max(J_teacher,J_candidate)<0 with the same component guards.
complete_policy_evaluation.negative_results_policy: All candidates and all failed constraints remain in the report. No replacement candidate will be generated after viewing these scores.

closed_loop_evaluation.role: post-selection diagnostic and task-success characterization; success labels cannot change the FCP acceptance decision
closed_loop_evaluation.primary_metric: unweighted task-macro success-rate difference versus context_base
secondary_metrics: task-then-seed hierarchical bootstrap 95% CI with 10000 draws and seed 0
closed_loop_evaluation.multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment across the six candidate-versus-control McNemar tests
closed_loop_evaluation.coverage: exactly one complete row for every candidate/task/seed; missing or duplicate rows are hard errors
closed_loop_evaluation.interpretation: The 10-seed matrix is a reduced evaluation and will not replace the existing 50-seed headline comparison.

hardware_evaluation.hypothesis: Packed W4 residency reduces peak device memory, while dynamic A8 and the current fused kernels may trade latency and board energy against native precision.
hardware_evaluation.device: one otherwise idle NVIDIA A40 48GB (GPU 4 at protocol freeze)
hardware_evaluation.checkpoint_and_input: Atomic-Seen checkpoint-60000 and frozen Atomic-Seen selection-buffer observations

execution.order: fixed as listed for trial 0, then deterministic cyclic rotations for trials 1 and 2
execution.synchronization: CUDA synchronize immediately before and after each timed inference
execution.idle_guard: abort a configuration if another compute process appears on the selected GPU

latency.scope: model-only end-to-end action-chunk inference, excluding simulator, client transport, and model load

reported: NVML peak process/device used MiB during measurement
peak_memory.reset: empty cache, synchronize, and reset CUDA peak statistics after warmup and before measurement

energy.sensor: NVIDIA NVML power.draw sampled through nvidia-smi at 10 Hz
reported: gross board joules per inference by trapezoidal integration
energy.idle_baseline: five seconds immediately before each measured trial
energy.scope_warning: GPU-board energy only; not whole-system or robot energy

hardware_evaluation.runtime_warning: Latency and energy describe the checked-in fused packed-W4 implementation on A40, not an optimized TensorRT deployment and not simulator wall time.
